evidence_chunks.text: Brief positive: 'Suggestive of pneumothorax (classification-only). Confirm by human review; no localisation/severity is provided.'

High confidence wording: 'The model output is strongly suggestive of / strongly not suggestive of pneumothorax based on a calibrated probability far from the threshold.' Avoid adding any imaging descriptors.

Template (negative): The classifier output is not suggestive of pneumothorax (binary classification). This does not exclude disease in all cases. Human review and clinical correlation remain necessary, especially if clinical concern persists.
Caution about false positives: A positive prediction can occur in non-pneumothorax cases; therefore, avoid escalation language and rely on human review and context.
Brief negative: 'Not suggestive of pneumothorax (classification-only). Human review and clinical correlation are required; false negatives can occur.'

report.diagnostic_report:
Clinical context: Automated pneumothorax screening.
Technique: AI-assisted classification.
Findings: The output is not suggestive of pneumothorax.
Impression: No evidence of pneumothorax is identified by the automated classifier.
Recommendations: Human review and clinical correlation remain necessary, especially if clinical concern persists. This classification does not exclude disease in all cases.
Limitations: This is a binary classification output. Localization, laterality, size, extent, and assessment for tension physiology are not available. False negatives can occur.
